title: AB-Cloud Research: a phase resonator for the zeros of the Riemann zeta function
description: The AB-cloud is a Hofstadter Hamiltonian decorated with topological vortices whose Aharonov-Bohm phases are derived from the non-trivial zeros of the Riemann zeta function. The repository contains: five monograph editions (v22 RU/EN/ZH + original author v21 RU/EN) in md/html/docx/pdf/pptx/tex with 131 figures at 600 dpi; the canonical 37-test two-pass Julia verification suite (dependency-free, interactive menu, Physics Lab with 22 experiments, 3D laboratory with 30 tests, --quick CI mode); an independent 10-language verification stack (C++, Fortran, Go, Haskell, JavaScript, Julia, MATLAB, Python, R, Rust) with zeta-zero datasets up to 2,000,000 zeros; and a 3D lattice laboratory (36³ Hofstadter lattices, 5000 embedded zeros).
